FORM_A_SELECTION_IMPLEMENTATION.row: action=tenancy.organization.selection_refused, reason=TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED, entity_type=user, entity_id=auth.uid(), actor_user_id=auth.uid(), organization_id NULL
FORM_A_SELECTION_IMPLEMENTATION.classification_owner: lib/audit/tenancy-refusal.ts, not the call site. The raw submitted value is passed through unclassified so that UUID shape is checked in exactly one place.
FORM_A_SELECTION_IMPLEMENTATION.redirect_hazard_handled: redirect() from next/navigation THROWS. The emission is placed BEFORE it and is deliberately NOT wrapped in try/catch, so it can neither be unreachable nor swallow the redirect's control-flow throw.

FORM_B_SELECTION_IMPLEMENTATION.malformed_input: Classified as FORM A by the emitter, so hostile bytes never reach the uuid subject column. Proven across six malformed shapes, and the raw bytes are asserted absent from EVERY field of the row, not only entity_id.
FORM_B_SELECTION_IMPLEMENTATION.no_existence_lookup: FORM B is emitted on UUID SHAPE alone. Proven non-vacuously by PG-POS-4: a Form B row naming an organisation that has NO organizations row is ACCEPTED. A lookup, if one were ever added, would make that probe red.

FORM_B_REVALIDATION_IMPLEMENTATION.form_A_inexpressible: emitMembershipRevalidationRefused has NO parameter that could produce a FORM A row. The prohibited pair is inexpressible in the emitter's signature, and refused by the database as a second wall.

ROUTINE_NO_ORG_NON_EVENT_PROOF.non_vacuous: The control asserts (a) that the site was genuinely REACHED -- organizationRefusalCode === TENANCY_NO_ORGANIZATION_SELECTED and membership === null -- and (b) that the audit row COUNT is unchanged across the resolution. Not merely that nothing threw.
ROUTINE_NO_ORG_NON_EVENT_PROOF.malformed_carrier_subcase_disclosed: A malformed selected-organization carrier also resolves to null at this site and is likewise NOT audited here. Distinguishing it would require changing lib/auth/selected-organization.ts, which is outside this node's ceiling. The explicit selection path remains fully audited, so a caller attempting to USE a malformed value through the governed act is still recorded.

THIRD_SITE_EXCLUSION_PROOF.site: lib/auth/database-context.ts return site 3 (membership EXISTS, organisation row unreadable)
THIRD_SITE_EXCLUSION_PROOF.why_this_is_the_likely_defect: The refusal code TENANCY_SELECTED_ORGANIZATION_NOT_A_MEMBER is returned at BOTH site 2 and site 3 and is TRUE at only one of them. An emitter keyed on the code would write a FALSE row here, asserting an absent membership that the same return object disproves.
THIRD_SITE_EXCLUSION_PROOF.how_it_is_prevented_structurally: readPrincipalUnderOpenContext returns a PrincipalRead carrying pendingRevalidationRefusal, set at exactly one RETURN SITE and never derived from organizationRefusalCode.
THIRD_SITE_EXCLUSION_PROOF.control_asserts: The control proves the site was reached with membership NON-NULL, organization NULL and the NOT_A_MEMBER code present, and that zero refusal rows were written.
THIRD_SITE_EXCLUSION_PROOF.successor_recorded_not_implemented: TENANCY_ORGANIZATION_READABILITY_INVARIANT_SUCCESSOR_REQUIRED, owner TO_BE_MAPPED. No verb, reason, policy or path was allocated for it by this node.

TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.architecture: readPrincipalUnderOpenContext RESOLVES the refusal facts and RETURNS the audit obligation; it never writes. resolveRequestPrincipal discharges the obligation AFTER withDatabaseIdentityContext has returned -- i.e. after the principal-resolution transaction has committed -- by opening a SECOND unscoped context.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.why_the_emitter_does_not_open_its_own_co: Two independent reasons, both load-bearing. (1) Isolation: deciding WHICH transaction the write joins belongs at the request boundary, where the principal transaction's lifetime is known. (2) The entrypoint ledger: tests/database-runtime-entrypoints.test.ts requires any app/ region importing a database-reaching symbol to itself call a named CONTEXT_OPENER; had the emitter opened its own context, the selector would import a database-reaching symbol while opening none and the pinned contextualized magnitude would fall from 100 to 99, a pin outside this ceiling.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.emitter_precondition: lib/audit/tenancy-refusal.ts REQUIRES an open, unscoped context for the exact subject and throws TenancyRefusalAuditError otherwise -- including when the open context is organisation-scoped, which would assert the very membership the refusal denies.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.borrowed_transaction_case: When resolveRequestPrincipal runs inside a context it did NOT open, it cannot commit that transaction nor open a sibling (re-entry with a matching identity reuses the open transaction). Writing there is the prohibited coupling and skipping the row is prohibited best-effort, so the lane fails LOUDLY with AuthContextError rather than choosing either.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.fail_closed: The emission is deliberately not wrapped in try/catch. A failing audit write propagates and the request fails.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.measured_oracle: The test double records BEGIN/COMMIT and stamps every insert with the transaction open at the time. Measured result: txLog === ['BEGIN tx1','COMMIT tx1','BEGIN tx2','COMMIT tx2'] and the refusal insert carries txId 'tx2'. An implementation writing inside the principal transaction would stamp 'tx1' and log a single BEGIN.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.both_halves_proven: Isolation (the transaction identity above) AND fail-closed (a failing insert rejects loadRequestPrincipalResult, with COMMIT tx1 already logged) are asserted by two separate controls.
TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY_IMPLEMENTATION.prohibited_none_used: No service role, no SECURITY DEFINER, no RLS bypass, no SET ROLE, no nested incompatible identity context. The write runs as uellix_app under the caller's own claims.

corrections.defect: Five positive probes verified the INSERT by reading the row back and reported 'inserted no row'.
corrections.root_cause: MEASURED, and it is a property of the contract rather than a bug in it: a refusal row carries organization_id NULL while audit_logs_select_member_or_admin matches only organization_id = ANY(current_user_org_ids()), so the row is invisible to its OWN AUTHOR the instant it is written. corrections.correction: INV-1 now names a FOREIGN organisation, leaving both policies as possible acceptors and requiring both to refuse.
